name: Luke Edmonds
why: Herald photograph of the SGA presidential debate of 10 April 2017, whose caption names one person only and gives him his SGA office. Four people are in the frame; three are foreground or background blur or are looking down at a magazine, and the caption describes its subject as watching the debate. The bearded man in the blue check shirt and red tie is the only figure in the plane of focus, the only full face in the frame, and the only person watching the front of the room, so he is the named senator. Edmonds is listed in the archive for 2015-16 and the frame is from his continuing service in April 2017; filed under the archive's year for him.
caption_quote: SGA Senator Luke Edmonds watches the debate between presidential candidates and their running mates

src.label: College Heights Herald, 12 April 2017, SGA presidential debate in Gary Ransdell Hall; cropped to Edmonds, the sharply focused figure the caption names
